title: Randomization Inference for Matched Pairs with Binary Outcomes
abstract: arXiv:2609.03227v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We give an exact randomization-based confidence set for the average treatment effect (ATE) in matched-pair studies with a binary outcome, requiring neither monotonicity nor any distributional assumption beyond the within-pair coin flip. At its core is an analytic solution to the worst-case allocation of attributable effects: two binomial-symmetry lemmas identify the pattern hardest to reject as a single boundary corner, so testing null hypotheses needs no integer program and no numerical search. Inverting the test via binary search yields a prediction set for the attributable effect in O(log S) Binomial tail calculations; the Bonferroni proposition of Rigdon and Hudgens (2015) produces the ATE confidence set at the same computational cost. translated_title: 配对设计中二元结果的随机化推断
translated_abstract: 我们给出了一种基于随机化的精确置信集，用于具有二元结果的配对研究中的平均处理效应（ATE），该方法既不需要单调性假设，也不需要配对内抛硬币之外的任何分布假设。其核心是可归因效应最坏情形分配的解析解：两个二项对称性引理证明最难拒绝的模式对应于单一边界角点，因此检验原假设无需整数规划，也无需数值搜索。通过二分搜索对检验进行反演，可在O(log S)次二项尾部计算内得到可归因效应的预测集；利用Rigdon和Hudgens（2015）的Bonferroni命题，能以相同的计算成本得到ATE置信集。同一角点结果无需额外工具即可扩展至Rosenbaum Γ模型下配对观察性研究的敏感性分析。一个关于设计敏感性的简单公式阐明了（摘要此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了针对二元结果配对研究中平均处理效应的精确随机化置信集，借助二项对称性引理获得最坏情形的解析解，从而免除整数规划与数值搜索，并可自然扩展至观察性研究的敏感性分析。
en_tdlr: This paper derives an exact randomization-based confidence set for the average treatment effect in matched-pair studies with binary outcomes, using binomial-symmetry lemmas to obtain an analytic worst-case solution that eliminates integer programming and numerical search, and extends naturally to sensitivity analysis for observational studies.
